news.title: The Clearly launcher is here
news.body: One click to get into the city. It keeps itself up to date and tells you when the server is open.

news.title: Stores and lottery
news.body: Corner stores have been reworked and scratch-offs are on the shelves. Good luck.

news.title: Join the Discord
news.body: Announcements, events and support all happen there. Read the rules before you set foot in town.

news.title: Dev and Live share a server for now
news.body: Both channels point at the same city until the dev branch gets its own server. Expect restarts and unfinished work here.
